Friendzy / Classic party games / One-Word Story

How to play One-Word Story

Tell a story — one word at a time Players build a story together, but each person contributes exactly one word per turn. The result is always unexpected, often grammatically criminal, and deeply funny.

2–8 players~8 minCreative & AbsurdActing & performance games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Players sit in a circle.
  2. Going around, each person adds exactly one word to build a story.
  3. No hesitation — you have 2 seconds to say your word.
  4. No correcting or directing other people's words.
  5. Tell the story for 3–5 minutes, then someone says 'THE END' to close it.

Example round

  • 'Once... upon... a... very... confused... fish... who... accidentally... invented... TikTok...'
  • Someone drops 'therefore' unexpectedly and breaks the flow. Genius.
  • Someone says 'SUDDENLY' every turn. Narrative masterpiece.

Tips

  • Try to connect your word to the actual story — random chaos is less fun than weird logic.
  • Conjunctions and transitions ('however', 'despite', 'meanwhile') are power moves.
